title: Windows: a service installed from an SSH session cannot register its logon task
goal: Windows: a service installed from an SSH session cannot register its logon task
acceptance: Test committed failing first: `windowsServiceUser` gives `COMPUTERNAME\\user` for a local account (also when USERDOMAIN is WORKGROUP) and `USERDOMAIN\\user` when USERDNSDOMAIN is set; on Tabgha an SSH install registers the task.
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
